definitions.explanation: Something that is not true; a false statement or representation.

examples.japanese: {偽|いつわ}りのない{気持|きも}ちだ。
examples.english: These are my true feelings (without falsehood).

examples.japanese: それは{偽|いつわ}りだった。
{看板|かんばん}に{偽|いつわ}りなし。
examples.english: Truth in advertising. (The sign doesn't lie.)
examples.notes: Idiom meaning the product/service lives up to its claims

notes:
{偽|いつわ}り is the noun form of the verb {偽|いつわ}る (to deceive, to lie).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {偽|いつわ}りのない: without falsehood, genuine, true
- {偽|いつわ}りなく: truthfully, honestly
- {看板|かんばん}に{偽|いつわ}りなし: truth in advertising (idiom)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {嘘|うそ}: lie (more common in everyday speech)
- {虚偽|きょぎ}: falsehood (formal, often legal contexts)
- {詐欺|さぎ}: fraud, swindle

NOTE:
{偽|いつわ}り is more literary and formal compared to {嘘|うそ}.
